title: DAIQ: Auditing Demographic Attribute Inference from Neutral Question in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with demographically neutral questions to infer the author's gender (Male/Female), measuring the inference response rate versus abstention, and analyzing whether the model's reasoning relies on stereotypes and conditions downstream text generation.

Evaluating models' propensity to infer the author's race or ethnicity (Black/White) from demographically neutral questions using the DAIQ framework, measuring how often they default to majority categories rather than abstaining.

Prompting models to guess the author's socioeconomic status (Low/High income) from demographically neutral queries to measure the rate of unwarranted demographic speculation and asymmetric defaulting.

Measuring the frequency with which models infer the author's geographic location (Urban/Rural) when given explicit instructions to analyze neutral text cues, assessing the failure to abstain under epistemic uncertainty.
Testing whether models baselessly infer an author's educational background (Low/High) from neutral, task-oriented questions, calculating the response rate of fabricated demographic attributions.
